title: Abyssals v0.90.37 — Willowglass Through-Road
notes: Willowglass Viaduct is now the first screen through Philomere’s eastern exit and leads onward to Rivercause Road. Rivercause returns through the bridge too; the old southern dead-end entrance is removed. Both full-height edges are generous tap and walk exit zones, with clear direction plaques and edge arrows. Aimon is nearly twice as large in the aerial view and bridge travel is three times faster: about 12 seconds running or 24 walking for the same 360 real steps. Follower placement supports the bridge grid. The original abbess story gate remains enforced, including for older bridge saves. Existing artwork, pouch upgrades, eggs, hatch progress, saves, lives, quests, prices and original signing are preserved.
